rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=120, pretrain_lr=0.0003, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.0, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-6 (breast ItNet v1). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-3 (a0.1) 0.8199; iter-4 (a0.05) 0.8666; iter-5 (a0.0) 0.8741 BEST. alpha monotone down = hr up -> the fixed DC step is NET-HARMFUL; at alpha=0 recon == pure pretrained SmallUNet denoiser. DC lever EXHAUSTED (last step only +0.0076). (2) FAILURE MODE: none active (above baseline); the remaining ceiling is DENOISER quality (recon is now purely its output). Levers: pretrain_lr, pretrain_epochs, unet_c, train_n. (3) ONE KNOB (compute-free): pretrain_lr 1e-3 -> 3e-4. All else = iter-5 (k1, a0.0, c16, ep120, train_n400, val_n200). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I lower the denoiser LR ~3x, I expect hr above 0.8741 because at ep120 lr=1e-3 the Adam denoiser likely oscillates near the optimum on 400 scenes; a gentler lr converges to a lower-loss (higher-SSIM/lower-RMSE) denoiser. FALSIFIER: if hr drops, 1e-3 was already well-tuned and lr is not the lever -> iter-7 tries a capacity/data denoiser move (unet_c or train_n with a compensating epoch cut). (5) BUDGET: float change only, ~1189s, in budget (+turbo qos). (6) Loop to iter-20.
